confirmed_errors.location: Accepted manuscript p. 19, footnote 8 & footnote 9; p. 20, section 4.2
confirmed_errors.reason: Reconciling prior adjudication with parent response: compatible two-decimal rounding in shipped (22.77 vs. 22.771) is acceptable, and df = 1 is explicitly confirmed by Footnote 9 ('our χ2 contrasts are always based on a 2x2 contingency table, so the degrees of freedom (df) are always 1'). However, shipped's sample size annotation N = 40 is demonstrably wrong: 40 is the number of learner texts sampled in the corpus (p. 12), whereas UAM Corpus Tool computed the 2x2 chi-square test on raw obligatory-context token frequencies (p. 18, section 3.3; p. 19, footnotes 7–8), which for progressive -ing are 18/38 (beginners) vs. 44/47 (intermediates), giving a contingency-table total of N = 38 + 47 = 85 (reproducing χ2 = 85*(18*3 - 20*44)^2 / (38*47*62*23) = 22.771). Because shipped has the wrong N annotation (N = 40) and blind provides only the bare number without df and N annotations, both are wrong and the full corrected statistic is X2(1, N = 85) = 22.771 (or 22.77 with two-decimal rounding).
